info.name: Gym Tracker API
info.description: AI-powered workout generation server. Start the server with `./gradlew :server:run` (defaults to mock mode).

request.description: Returns server status and current mode (mock or live).
Generate a chest-focused workout for an intermediate lifter with barbell, dumbbell, and cable equipment.
No target specified — the AI picks the best muscle groups based on goal and history.
Full context request: profile with injuries, recent sessions, and weekly summaries. Shows the complete context the AI uses to generate a tailored workout.
User kept 2 exercises and rejected 2. The AI replaces rejected exercises while keeping the accepted ones in position.
Generate a weekly training split. Returns 7 days with focus areas and rest days.
Beginner with recent training history — the AI considers what they've already done this week.
Compress a week's worth of sessions (3 workouts: chest, legs, back) into a ~100-token summary. The AI identifies progression trends, consistency patterns, and notable events.
Compress 4 weekly summaries into a monthly trend report. Captures progression, preferences, and patterns across the month.
